messages:
clare - design: dropped a compact empty-state mock for the Keys page + a tiny starter checklist. goal: reduce first-time friction. figma: https://figma.com/file/starter-keys

mike - eng: looks tidy. two backend notes: (1) we can prefill rotation presets in the API, (2) we return last_rotated and last_used metadata. include that in the mock.

yo - ux: checklist idea is great. propose the collapsed checklist have three bullets: who can manage keys, rotation policy, audit logs. each bullet should expand inline to a 1-sentence description. keep collapsed by default.

clare - design: will do. also adding a primary CTA named "Create API key" and a secondary inline action "Set rotation policy (30d)" so people can take either action from the empty state.

tara - product: copy tweak: change the lead sentence from "No keys yet" to "No active API credentials" 12 more specific. Add microcopy under the CTA: "TIP: create a scoped key for services and set a rotation policy to reduce risk."

ben - support: please add a short help link: "After you create a key" with steps to update clients. Many tickets start with "I rotated but my service failed". that doc should be front-and-center.

yo - ux: accessibility: ensure the collapsed checklist is keyboard-expandable and announces expansion state with aria-expanded. the quick action "Set rotation policy (30d)" should open the scheduling modal with focus on the preset selector.

mike - eng: small API snippet for the schedule prefill we can show in docs pane:

```
POST /v1/keys
{
  "name": "svc-worker",
  "scopes": ["read"],
  "rotation_policy": "30d"
}
```

clare - design: I'll add a small chevron to reveal the API example. also including a one-line explainer: "Secrets are shown once; copy now." next to the secret preview.

tara - product: permission flows: if a user lacks key.create, show a "Request access" link that opens a prefilled request modal. include estimated SLA: "Admins typically respond within 24h" to reduce follow-ups.

ben - support: for revoke/rotate language in the empty state guidance, include a short line: "Rotate issues a new key and keeps the old one for a short undo window; revoke immediately invalidates the key." helps set expectations.

yo - ux: keyboard order for the Create flow should be: Name -> Scopes -> Rotation policy -> Create -> Copy secret. ensure focus is visible on all interactive elements.

mike - eng: note for front-end: mask secret after 30s unless user toggles "Keep visible". audit log will record creation and copy events. infra-bot: confirm config?

infra-bot: config:key.secret_visibility_seconds=30. audit events: key.create, key.copy.

clare - design: timeline: i'll push v2 with collapsed checklist, API example, and updated CTAs by EOD. tagging accessibility for a quick pass tomorrow. :sparkles:
